title: Random Cayley sum hypergraphs and $k$-fold sumsets
summary: We denote by $f_k(Γ)$ the largest integer with the property that every subset of a finite abelian group $Γ$ of size at least $|Γ| - f_k(Γ)$ is a $k$-fold sumset. Extending a recent result of Alon and Pham, we prove that $$ f_k(Γ) \leq \widetilde{O} \left(n^{(2k-1)/(4k-3)}\right) $$ holds for all finite abelian groups $Γ$ and integers $k \geq 2$, where $n = |Γ|$. Additionally, we also show that the lower bound $f_k(Γ) \geq \widetildeΩ \left(n^{1/k}\right)$ holds if $Γ$ has no nontrivial element of order dividing $k$.
